config.historical_split_reason: Chosen on odds coverage only before calculating scores: Pinnacle columns stop in January 2026, so a February boundary would leave no market-informed audit cohort. Both periods remain retrospective and already inspected.
config.promotion_policy: No automatic promotion. Historical periods have already been inspected and are retrospective diagnostics. Select candidates using development only; audit scores cannot select. A candidate needs later, genuinely untouched pre-kickoff forecasts, adequate paired coverage, calibration checks and manual approval before production changes. Historical closing inputs are oracle diagnostics and never promotion-eligible. No ROI, CLV or live bet recommendation can be inferred from these untimestamped CSV odds.

limitations: Retrospective diagnostics only. Historical periods were already examined by Claude and are not untouched evidence. Nominal opening odds lack exact availability timestamps; no historical betting edge/ROI/CLV claim is made. Closing inputs are explicitly oracle/evaluation-only. Baseline fixes half-life at 240 days rather than replaying production tuning. Fitted rho is retained for totals scaling. No bookmaker fallback, new data download or automatic production change.
